audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3 and 4 said Skill and row 6 said Olaf, while whys[0] claimed level 1 'favours you' against a Skill row and whys[2] claimed level 3 favours you against an Olaf row.
audit.why: The mirror applied Olaf from level 2 through first item and Warwick at two-plus items. That matches the kit: his edge is true damage plus missing-health lifesteal in the mid game, and yours is max-health damage with Grievous Wounds once you have items.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 4 to Olaf, row 6 to Warwick as matched pairs; every contradicting why rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike credited Olaf's healing to 'Vicious Strikes'.
audit.why: Olaf's W is Tough It Out — attack speed and a shield, 16/15/14/13/12s. His sustain is the passive, Berserker Rage, which scales attack speed and lifesteal off missing health. Vicious Strikes is an old name that no longer exists in his kit.
audit.corrected: Renamed to Berserker Rage across both layers and re-keyed the spikes to Ragnarok's 100/90/80s cooldown and Reckless Swing's 11-7s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text referenced a 'Primal Howl slow' and a Warwick 'Q reset'.
audit.why: Primal Howl grants 2.5s damage reduction and fears for 1s — no slow. Jaws of the Beast is a 365-range lunge, not an auto reset; the reset in this lane is Olaf's Undertow refunding its 9s cooldown when he picks the axe up. Ragnarok's disable immunity is the decisive interaction: it blanks both the fear and the suppression while he keeps attacking.
audit.corrected: Both errors removed; Undertow's axe-pickup reset and Ragnarok's immunity now carry the advice.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Olaf's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Ragnarok is 100s at rank 1 and makes him immune to disables while he keeps attacking, so Infinite Duress does nothing until he has spent it. Bait, then commit.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ragnarok's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His window: Reckless Swing is true damage on 11-7s and Berserker Rage heals him harder the lower he gets. Farm, and fight only with the jungler.

edits.before: Level 1 favours you because neither spikes and you control the trade tempo early.
edits.after: Level 1 is even — neither of you spikes and Undertow is his only reach yet.

edits.before: Level 2 is even as both farm toward a first spike with no decisive combo yet.
edits.after: Level 2 is his: Reckless Swing is true damage your armour cannot answer.

edits.before: Level 3 favours you: your Q reset lands before Olaf's lifesteal and Swing scaling come online.
edits.after: Level 3 is still his: Reckless Swing's true damage on an 11s cooldown beats your Jaws.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 swing to Olaf once Vicious Strikes healing and true-damage Reckless Swing win extended trades.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are his: Berserker Rage's missing-health lifesteal and Reckless Swing win long trades.

edits.before: Level 6 is yours because Infinite Duress suppresses Olaf as long as Ragnarok is on cooldown.
edits.after: Level 6 is his: Ragnarok's disable immunity blanks Infinite Duress while he keeps swinging.

edits.before: Two-plus items stays Olaf's — true damage and Vicious Strikes healing beat you in any sustained fight.
edits.after: Two-plus items turns to you: max-health damage plus Grievous Wounds cut through his lifesteal.

edits.before: Early you match Olaf's sustain with Jaws heal, but once he has Reckless Swing and Vicious Strikes his lifesteal-fueled trades start winning any toe-to-toe.
edits.after: Early you match his sustain with the Jaws heal, but Reckless Swing (11-7s) is true damage and Berserker Rage hands him more attack speed and lifesteal the lower he drops.

edits.before: With Ragnarok plus a bruiser item Olaf becomes an unstoppable, lifesteal-healing threat who ignores your Primal Howl slow and out-DPSes your all-in.
edits.after: With Ragnarok (100s at rank 1) plus a bruiser item he shrugs off both Primal Howl's fear and your suppression while he keeps attacking, and out-damages your all-in.

edits.before: Olaf's true-damage Reckless Swing and Vicious Strikes healing let him win extended duels; never fight him while Ragnarok is active.
edits.after: Reckless Swing's true damage and Berserker Rage lifesteal win his duels; buy Grievous Wounds and never fight into an active Ragnarok.

edits.before: Level 3 is a brief window for you, but Olaf's Vicious Strikes lifesteal and true-damage Reckless Swing take over by 4-5; your one real edge is level 6, where Infinite Duress suppresses him if Ragnarok is down, so bait his ult before committing.
edits.after: Level 3 is a brief window, but Berserker Rage's missing-health lifesteal and true-damage Reckless Swing take over by 4-5; your one real edge is Ragnarok's 100s cooldown — bait it out, then suppress him and commit everything.

edits.before: Past the first item Olaf is a nightmare: Ragnarok makes him immune to your R and Primal Howl, his Swing does true damage, and Vicious Strikes heals him through your DPS, so only all-in him when his ult is on cooldown.
edits.after: Past the first item Olaf is a nightmare: Ragnarok blanks your suppression and Primal Howl while he attacks, Reckless Swing is true damage, and Berserker Rage heals him harder the lower he drops — all-in only on his ult cooldown.

notes: Undertow carries a derived grounding flag ('shuts off enemy dashes') that Riot's description does not support — it lists armour and move-speed reduction only — so no grounding claim was written. Whether Ragnarok cleanses an Infinite Duress that has already landed, or only prevents a new one, is not in the text; copy says only that it blanks the suppression while he keeps attacking, matching the mirror. Packet header disagrees with itself on sample size: brief games=977, packet games=499.
